display_long_description:
[App Introduction]

Maximize work efficiency with VIRNECT View.

Easily augment manuals on actual equipment to confirm equipment usage.

Check real-time field data and operate processes efficiently.

Shorten training time for new employees by utilizing realistic educational content.

[Main Features]

Spatial-based AR Content Visualization
Allows for more accurate problem confirmation than paper manuals

Offline Environment Support
Download AR content to your device for easy access even in offline environments.

Real-time Data Monitoring
Connects data information to content for direct on-site viewing.

Work Result Report Writing
Create reports while viewing AR content.
(Supports text input, photo capture, and checklist-style work reporting)

Immersive Content
Provides a more immersive content experience through various animations and interaction functions.

[Access Permission Guide]

If necessary access is not allowed, there may be restrictions on service usage.

[Open Source License Guide]

In-App Information Notification

[Customer Support Center]

https://virnect.com/support/inquiry

[Website]

https://virnect.com/

This is an enterprise app. Please purchase licenses from the payment center (web) to use.
